fb-a.name: Full Body A
fb-a.focus: Chest press · row · quads · hamstrings · triceps

items.label: Chest Press
items.cue: Handles at mid-chest. Press, don't shrug. Two warm-up sets at half weight first.

items.label: Seated Cable Row
items.cue: Sit tall, pull to the navel, squeeze the shoulder blades, slow return.

items.label: Leg Extension
items.cue: Roller on the shins, kick to full lock, squeeze one second, lower slow.

items.label: Standing Leg Curl
items.cue: Face the seat, hands on the backrest. Hook one heel behind the lower roller, curl it to your glute, knee pointing down, lower slow. Two plates lighter than extensions. Awkward? Ankle strap on the low pulley, cable behind you, same move.

items.label: Rope Pushdown
items.cue: Elbows pinned to your sides, split the rope at the bottom.

items.label: Cable Crunch
items.cue: Optional. Rope beside the ears, curl the ribs to the hips, hips stay still.

fb-b.name: Full Body B
fb-b.focus: Pulldown · pec deck · split squat · hamstrings · biceps

items.label: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
items.cue: Chest up, bar to the upper chest, elbows down and back. Two warm-up sets first.

items.label: Pec Deck
items.cue: Elbows soft, squeeze the pads together, 2-second return.

items.label: Split Squat
items.station: Floor · hold a weight plate or bodyweight
items.cue: Long stance, back knee to the floor, front heel stays down.

items.label: Standing Leg Curl
items.cue: Face the seat, hands on the backrest. Hook one heel behind the lower roller, curl it to your glute, knee pointing down, lower slow. Two plates lighter than extensions. Awkward? Ankle strap on the low pulley, cable behind you, same move.

items.label: Cable Preacher Curl
items.station: Low pulley · silver bar on the arm-curl pad
items.cue: Upper arms glued to the pad. Full stretch at the bottom, no bouncing.

items.label: Cable Wood Chop
items.cue: Optional. Arms straight, rotate from the hips, pivot the back foot.

fb-c.name: Full Body C
fb-c.focus: Shoulder press · underhand pulldown · quads · squat · rear + side delts

items.label: Cable Shoulder Press
items.cue: Bar to collarbone, press overhead, ribs down. Step back one foot from the pulley. Two warm-up sets first.

items.label: Underhand Pulldown
items.station: High pulley · lat bar, shoulder-width underhand
items.cue: Lean back slightly, drive the elbows into your pockets.

items.label: Leg Extension
items.cue: Lighter than A. Two-second squeeze at the top.

items.label: Squat
items.station: Floor · bodyweight or hold a plate at the chest
items.cue: Feet shoulder width, sit between the heels, chest tall.

items.label: Face Pull
items.cue: Pull to the forehead, elbows high, finish with a double-biceps pose.

items.label: Cable Lateral Raise
items.station: Low pulley · single strap, one arm
items.cue: Cable crosses in front of your body. Lead with the elbow, stop at shoulder height.

warmup.label: Arm Circles
warmup.cue: Big slow circles, forward then backward. Loosen the shoulders.

warmup.label: Dynamic Chest Stretch
warmup.cue: Swing the arms open and closed across the chest, a little further each time.

warmup.label: Bodyweight Squats
warmup.cue: Fifteen easy squats. Warm the knees and hips, sit deep.

warmup.label: Inchworms
warmup.cue: Walk the hands out to a plank, walk the feet in. Five reps.

cooldown.label: Chest Stretch
cooldown.cue: Hands on the frame behind you, lean forward until the chest opens.

cooldown.label: Lat Stretch
cooldown.cue: Hold the frame overhead, sit the hips back and away from the hand.

cooldown.label: Quad Stretch
cooldown.cue: Heel to glute, knees together, hips forward.

cooldown.label: Hamstring Stretch
cooldown.cue: Heel on the seat, leg straight, hinge from the hips.

cooldown.label: Hip Flexor Stretch
cooldown.cue: Back knee down, tuck the pelvis, push the hips forward.

cooldown.label: Child's Pose
cooldown.cue: Sit back on the heels, arms long, breathe slow. Done.
